-- Perfumum Glossary table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS perfumum_glossary (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  term_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  term VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  definition_fr TEXT NOT NULL,
  definition_en TEXT,
  category VARCHAR(100),
  related_terms JSON,
  related_axes JSON,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX pg_term_idx (term)
);

-- Scent Blends table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scent_blends (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  blend_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  climate_axis ENUM('vent', 'bois', 'peau', 'disparition') NOT NULL,
  intended_medium ENUM('parfum', 'encens', 'espace') NOT NULL,
  concept VARCHAR(255),
  materials JSON,
  safety_notes TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX sb_axis_idx (climate_axis),
  INDEX sb_medium_idx (intended_medium)
);

-- Climate Axis Matrix table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS climate_axis_matrix (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  climate_axis ENUM('vent', 'bois', 'peau', 'disparition') NOT NULL,
  medium ENUM('parfum', 'encens', 'espace') NOT NULL,
  target_diffusion ENUM('low', 'medium', 'high') DEFAULT 'medium',
  target_persistence ENUM('short', 'medium', 'long') DEFAULT 'medium',
  volatility_bias ENUM('top', 'heart', 'base') DEFAULT 'heart',
  carrier_or_support VARCHAR(255),
  safety_notes TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX cam_axis_idx (climate_axis),
  INDEX cam_medium_idx (medium)
);
